facts.function: engine control: integrated valve actuator plus electronic (digital) engine controllers that regulate engine parameters automatically
facts.form: finished control units and an actuator

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9032 covers automatic regulating or controlling instruments and apparatus; chapter 90 note 7 defines them
GRI 6: 9032.89 Other, 9032.89.60 Other, residual statistical line 85

rejected_alternatives.reason: valve heading; the goods are principally engine controls and the controllers are not valves
K89109 puts a bare DC-motor actuator there, but an integrated valve actuator sold with the controller as a control system is treated here
programmable or control boards for switching/distribution are not what engine speed/fuel controllers are; ruling K89109 uses 9032 for the controller

missing_facts: whether the integrated valve actuator is imported separately and is a motor-driven or hydraulic device
classify separately: APECS 500 Single Speed Electronic Engine Controller and APECS digital controllers
classification.rationale: K89109 (in force) holds a controller imported separately, and a governor system imported as a unit, in 9032.89.6085 as an automatic regulating apparatus under chapter 90 note 7. Electronic engine controllers that regulate engine operation follow that. The actuator is uncertain; it was treated as part of the control system.
